title: Hub management
description: The workstations and servers paired with this hub. Each device acts as the user it was paired for.

devices.label: Devices
devices.outdatedHint: Its connector isn't on the hub's version. It updates itself when it connects.
devices.failedRollback: Version {{version}} did not start on the device, so it went back.
devices.emptyBody: Pair a device so its connector can work with this hub.
devices.name: Name
devices.revokeBody: The device loses access at once. Its local files stay on its disk. To use it again, pair it with a new code.

sync.idle_one: Hub folders up to date · {{count}} file
sync.idle_other: Hub folders up to date · {{count}} files
sync.syncing_one: Syncing the hub folders, {{count}} change waiting
sync.syncing_other: Syncing the hub folders, {{count}} changes waiting
sync.paused_one: Sync paused: {{count}} file deleted in {{roots}} at once. Confirm or restore it on the device's status page.
sync.paused_other: Sync paused: {{count}} files deleted in {{roots}} at once. Confirm or restore them on the device's status page.

devices.noProjects: No projects selected yet. Open on a project page adds one.
devices.noSlicers: No slicer found, so files can't be opened on this device.

edit.portHint: The connector's page on its own computer. A new port applies after a restart.
edit.autostartHint: Starts the connector when you log in.
edit.restartRequired: Saved. Restart the connector to use port {{port}}.
edit.offline: The connector is offline, so it didn't get this.
edit.outdated: This connector is too old for this. Update or restart it on its computer, then try again.
edit.timeout: The connector didn't answer. Try again.
edit.offlineNote: The connector is offline. This can only be changed while it is online.
edit.restarting: Restarting. It shows online again in a few seconds.

changeUser.title: Change this connector's user
changeUser.hint: It will act as this user, with their role. Nothing changes until the code is entered on the connector.
changeUser.codeBody: Enter this code on this connector's status page. It works once, until {{time}}, only on {{name}}, and isn't shown again.

pair.title: Pair a device
pair.hint: The device will act as this user, with their role.

code.title: Pairing code
code.body: Enter this code on the connector's status page. It works once, until {{time}}, and isn't shown again.

settings.title: Sync
settings.deleteGuard: Pause after this many deletes at once
settings.deleteGuardHint: When a device deletes more files than this from one hub folder at once, its sync pauses and asks on the device's status page before anything moves to the hub's trash.

lockHints.off: Anyone can edit a hub file on any device at the same time. Clashing saves become conflict copies.
lockHints.on: Opening a file on a workstation, or the first save there, checks it out. Other devices can only read it until it's released.
lockHints.strict: As On, and a device that is offline can only read hub files, because it can't check them out.

settings.lockIdle: Release a checked-out file after this many minutes without a save
settings.lockIdleHint: Closing the slicer (Windows and Linux) and Done editing release a file at once. This catches the rest.
settings.defaultSyncModeHint: What a newly paired device syncs to start with. You can change it per device on its edit page.
settings.versionsHint: When a device's save replaces a hub file, the old content is kept. Changes made directly on the hub's own disk are not kept. Backups include the versions, so they grow.
settings.versionsKeepHint: Lowering this deletes the older versions now.

presets.emptyBody: Turn on User presets Share for a machine on its page, or upload a slicer zip in Catalog settings → Sources. Their user presets join this library.
presets.noMatch: No preset of this type has that in its name.
presets.noneOfKind: No presets of this type yet.
presets.conflictsHint: A device saved its own version of a preset that had changed on the hub, so it was kept under a new name. Download both, keep what you need in your slicer, then delete the copy.
presets.deleteBody: It's removed from the hub's slicer, the slice workers and every device with Install on, unless a device's copy has edits it hasn't sent yet. Slices that used it need slicing again. On a PC signed in to Bambu Studio, delete it in the slicer too. Restore brings it back.
presets.removedInUse: Removed on {{devices}}, still in use: it goes once nothing uses it
presets.heldMass: Removed on {{device}} with many others at once: waits for you
presets.heldShared: Removed on {{device}}, whose slicer account another user's device shares: waits for you
presets.heldHint: A delete in a slicer reaches every device. These were held, because many went at once or because another user's device shares that slicer account, where a cloud sync can delete files nobody chose to delete. Delete them, or keep them: they're then written back to that device.
presets.heldSharedOn_one: {{device}} removed {{count}} preset on a shared slicer account
presets.heldSharedOn_other: {{device}} removed {{count}} presets on a shared slicer account
presets.deletedHint: Restore brings a preset back as its next version, and devices with Install on get it again.
presets.deviceOutdated: Its connector is older than the hub: its deletes only show here, and the hub's don't reach it. Update the connector.
presets.noBackup: No backup yet. One is made before the first write.
presets.editsStayLocal: This slicer's cloud account only takes new presets written to disk. An edit from the hub stays on this PC, and the cloud keeps the old version for other PCs.
presets.deleteHere_one: {{count}} preset deleted on the hub is still here. This slicer's cloud account brings back a file deleted from disk, so delete it in the slicer:
presets.deleteHere_other: {{count}} presets deleted on the hub are still here. This slicer's cloud account brings back a file deleted from disk, so delete them in the slicer:

machine.offline: Offline: changes apply when it reconnects.
machine.useAsSlicerOf: Use {{name}} on this machine as a slicer for the hub

receiveOf.system: Receive the {{name}} system presets, brands and printer models from the hub
receiveOf.presets: Receive {{name}} user presets from the hub

shareOf.presets: Share {{name}} user presets with the hub

machine.foldersHint: Its shared folders are picked on its connector page for now.
machine.stopReceivingBody: Its copies of hub projects are removed from the machine. Nothing is deleted on the hub.
machine.stopBody: It goes offline and starts again only when someone logs in on that computer or starts it by hand.
machine.stopped: Stopped. It shows offline in a few seconds.

errors.hubSlicer: This is the hub's slicer: its catalog is the hub's. Pick another in Integrations first.

machine.installInIntegrations: Install a slicer on this machine in Integrations
